character.temperament: Chill but vicious: small, quiet and unbothered — until she is provoked, and the provocation is her brother Willie's constant meowing. Then she beats him up; she always wins their fights, despite weighing half what he does.

palette.provenance: From Daniel's photos of the real Aggie (cat_kit/reference/reference-aggie-drawer.jpg and reference-aggie-plant.jpg): a dark calico (Daniel's recorded word for her coat) — warm black-brown base #241C17 (photo median) with irregular orange #B06E2C and cream #BFA87A mottling over the whole coat, a mostly dark face with orange mottling and a cream/orange throat and chest, a dark tail with orange running through it, and green-gold eyes. The mottling is baked into her coat texture itself (pass 3: the calico pattern composed in the texture over the dark base — broad blotches, marbling and speckle, no scatter shells); mottle.seed makes her build identically every run.

character.temperament: A total asshole (the owner's words, affectionate): knocks drinks and his own water bowl everywhere, scratches the fuck out of the furniture, shits right beside the litter box in the basement, and meows constantly, like a shithead.

palette.provenance: Daniel's ruled spec (director's call, 2026-10-25) — canonical, superseding the photo-tuned pass: pure white face blaze, muzzle, chest, belly, legs and paws; ginger #E8AF54 (the colour Daniel specified) as a cap wrapping the top of the head around the ears and down the sides of the cheeks and a LARGE saddle over the whole back and upper sides, with faint darker tabby striping (ginger_dark #AE833C, derived from #E8AF54 by the same per-channel factors — 0.75, 0.75, 0.72 — the earlier pass applied to its base); tail WHITE with a ginger underside (no rings); eyes DARK (#1A1412); small pink nose. The previous build's photo-tuned values (ginger #C97020, ginger_dark #975417, green-gold eyes, substantially ginger ringed tail) are a spec defect under the ruling and must not drift back: tests/smoke.gd spec-locks these constants. Photos in cat_kit/reference/ remain the build and pattern reference.
